## Customer Support

Get expert assistance for your Harmony Healthcare IT solutions and services.

## Customer Assistance

#### Choose the support path that fits your needs and get fast, reliable assistance.

#### HealthData Archiver®, HealthData Locker™, & HealthData AR Manager®

Log in to the Harmony Healthcare IT Support Portal to submit a ticket, view your request history, access release notes, or request an upgrade.

New to the portal? Use the self-service registration link on the login page to create your account. Our support team is also available by phone and email.

[800.781.1044](tel:800.781.1044)

[support@harmonyhit.com](mailto:support@harmonyhit.com)

[Access the Support Portal](https://harmonyhit.thecustomerspot.com/auth/login)

#### ClearView™ & Convergence™

ClearView™ or Convergence™ customers can access specialized support resources including the customer support portal, documentation portal, government user queues, and account management tools. New users can self-register or email our team directly.

[800.781.1044](tel:800.781.1044)

[clientcare@harmonyhit.com](mailto:clientcare@harmonyhit.com)

[View Support Resources](https://www.harmonyhit.com/customer-support-for-clearway-clearview-convergence/)

#### Medical Manager® Practice Management

We provide personalized software support and IT services for practices using The Medical Manager® practice management software. Our support analysts are dedicated to meeting your needs. Visit our dedicated site for help desk support, EDI options, and resources.

[800.781.1044](tel:800.781.1044)

[support@harmonyhit.com](mailto:support@harmonyhit.com)

[Visit MedicalManagerUsers.com](https://medicalmanagerusers.com/)
